title: GOV-004 Moderation Decision Audit Binding

binding.actor: server-derived reviewer actor from admitted authenticated principal

invariants: Every authoritative moderation decision mutation emits exactly one immutable AuditEvent after the decision authority has accepted the mutation.
AuditEvent actor is server-derived and MUST NOT be taken from client reviewer fields.
The audit target is the authoritative ModerationCase identifier; content identifiers remain logical references.
Audit persistence uses the existing W06/D1-03 AuditEvent authority; no second audit table is created.
Audit failure MUST NOT create a successful moderation decision result; the admitted transaction path must define atomic/compensating behavior before runtime authorization.
Audit records are not user-erasure-deleted under the canonical AuditEvent contract.
nonGoals: No raw evidence or internal risk thresholds in audit payload.
No runtime or remote evidence claim.
verificationRequirements: negative evidence for client reviewer spoofing
